data.title: XPEL, Inc. 2Q 2026: Revenue $143.05M, EPS $0.65— 10-Q Summary
data.description:
XPEL, Inc. reported second-quarter 2026 results with revenue of $143.05M, up 14.7% from $124.71M a year earlier, and diluted EPS of $0.65 versus $0.59 in the prior-year quarter; net income was $18.04M, a 10.7% increase year over year.

Financial Highlights

MetricCurrent quarterPrior year quarterYoY change
Revenue¹$143.05M$124.71M14.7%
Net income²$18.04M$16.29M10.7%
Diluted EPS³$0.65$0.5910.2%

¹ Reported as “Total revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income attributable to stockholders of the Company”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings per share attributable to stockholders of the Company”.

Business Highlights

  • Revenue growth was broad-based, driven by higher global product demand; product sales outpaced services, with paint protection film and window film leading product growth.
  • China expansion was a major contributor, with China revenue up 106.7% in the quarter (74.8% for the six months) following direct market presence and a distributor acquisition, and the company also added a China manufacturing facility.
  • Installation revenue and software subscribers increased, and XPEL continued to expand its retail footprint and OEM/dealer adoption.
  • Operational investment included acquisition of a 431,000 sq ft San Antonio site to expand North American production capacity.

data.title: Kestrel Group Ltd Q2 2026: Revenue $6.69M, EPS $(1.03) — 10-Q Summary
data.description:
Kestrel Group Ltd reported results for the quarter ended Q2 2026 with revenue rising to $6.69M, while the company recorded a net loss of $(8.08)M and diluted loss per share of $(1.03), reflecting a prior-year bargain purchase gain that materially boosted the comparable period.

Financial Highlights

  • Revenue was $6.686M for Q2 2026, up from $5.566M in the year-ago quarter; YoY change 20.1%.
  • Net income was $(8.082)M for Q2 2026, versus $69.927M in the year-ago quarter (prior-period included a bargain purchase gain).
  • Diluted earnings per share was $(1.03) for Q2 2026, versus $15.05 in the year-ago quarter.

Business Highlights

  • Completed the May 27, 2025 combination with Maiden, creating a capital-light, fee-focused insurance platform and prioritizing growth in Program Services.
  • Program Services fee revenue surged, totaling $3.7M in Q2 and $6.9M year-to-date, driven by higher premium production from large client programs.
  • Fee revenue remains concentrated: one large client accounted for roughly 82% of fees year-to-date, though multiple sub-programs support ongoing diversification.
  • Continuing run-off management of Maiden legacy reinsurance portfolios with active pursuit of finality solutions and disposal of alternative assets to bolster liquidity.
  • Paused new alternative investment commitments and prioritized asset disposals and selective underwriting deployment to support expansion of the fee business.

Original SEC Filing: Kestrel Group Ltd [ KG ] - 10-Q - Aug. 07, 2026

Assured Guaranty Ltd Q2 2026: Revenue $195M, EPS $0.88— 10-Q Summary
data.description:
Assured Guaranty Ltd reported results for the second quarter of 2026 with total revenues of $195M and diluted EPS of $0.88, down from $281M revenue and $2.08 EPS in the year‑ago quarter; net income attributable to the company was $39M versus $103M in Q2 2025.

Financial Highlights

  • Revenue was $195M in Q2 2026, compared with $281M in Q2 2025.
  • Net income attributable to Assured Guaranty Ltd. was $39M in Q2 2026, compared with $103M in Q2 2025.
  • Diluted EPS was $0.88 in Q2 2026, compared with $2.08 in Q2 2025.

Business Highlights

  • Adjusted operating income was supported by growth in the Financial Guaranty segment while annuity reinsurance and asset management added diversified fee streams.
  • New business production: present value of premiums (PVP) rose to $79M driven mainly by infrastructure and fund finance; gross par written shifted toward shorter‑duration structured deals.
  • Annuity reinsurance expanded after the January 2026 acquisition of Warwick/Assured Life Re, adding PRT and MYGA platforms and associated asset‑liability hedging capabilities.
  • Investment strategy: a $1B commitment to Sound Point targets alternative credit to reallocate alternatives and enhance returns.
  • Loss mitigation: active workouts, purchases and legal actions (including matters in Puerto Rico and Brightline) continued to reduce insured losses and improve recoveries.

Original SEC Filing: ASSURED GUARANTY LTD [ AGO ] - 10-Q - Aug. 07, 2026

ATOSSA THERAPEUTICS, INC. Q2 2026: Net loss $(8.49M), EPS $(0.95) — 10-Q Summary
data.description:
Atossa Therapeutics, Inc. reported a net loss for the second quarter of 2026, with net loss of $(8.49M) and diluted loss per share of $(0.95). Cash and cash equivalents totaled $26.1M at June 30, 2026, and the company disclosed substantial doubt about its ability to continue as a going concern.

Financial Highlights

  • Net income: $(8.49M) loss for Q2 2026, compared with $(8.42M) loss in Q2 2025.
  • Diluted EPS: $(0.95) for Q2 2026, versus $(0.98) in the year-ago quarter.
  • Cash & liquidity note: Cash and cash equivalents $26.1M at June 30, 2026 (working capital $25.6M); company reports substantial doubt about going concern.

Business Highlights

  • Clinical program progress: Advanced (Z)-endoxifen across four Phase 2 trials (Karisma, I-SPY, RECAST, EVANGELINE) with ongoing enrollments and expected data readouts in H2 2026.
  • Clinical efficacy signals: Reported biological activity including reduced mammographic breast density, Ki-67 suppression, MRI tumor volume reductions and ctDNA clearance.
  • Regulatory & orphan designations: Secured Rare Pediatric Disease and Orphan Drug designations for DMD and a Rare Pediatric Disease designation for MAS, supporting potential PRV value.
  • Manufacturing & IP: Established a proprietary manufacturing process, multiple dosage strengths, seven U.S. and 16 international patents with protection through at least 2038.
  • Capital raises & runway: Completed a $4.0M registered direct offering and initiated an ATM program to support near-term operations and upcoming trial milestones.

Original SEC Filing: ATOSSA THERAPEUTICS, INC. [ ATOS ] - 10-Q - Aug. 07, 2026
